title: AMF crashes when gNB with 40+ connected UE's disconnects
body:
Hi,

I'm running open5gs and UERANSIM on two different machines.
While testing open5gs with UERANSIM I ran into the following problem:

If I have a gNB with around 40 connected UE's and disconnect the gNB from open5gs, the amf is reliable crashing with the following error:

> 04/08 17:46:50.778: [amf] INFO: gNB-N2[10.3.2.1] connection refused!!! (../src/amf/amf-sm.c:641)
> 04/08 17:46:50.783: [amf] INFO: [Removed] Number of gNBs is now 0 (../src/amf/context.c:893)
> 04/08 17:46:50.807: [sbi] FATAL: sock_new: Assertion `sockinfo' failed. (../lib/sbi/client.c:602)
> 04/08 17:46:50.807: [core] FATAL: backtrace() returned 12 addresses (../lib/core/ogs-abort.c:37)

I've tried to reproduce this with 10-50 UE's, and can reliably reproduce it with 40+ UE's.

I used Version 2.2.5, as well as the current main branch, to test this case.

When I have a low number of UE's (e.g. 14 ) and disconnect the gNB, the amf doesn't crash.
